name: JavDB v3
deviceFindingsFromTest2: Search Hub input button text was too long and consumed excessive horizontal space.
Third-party playback became compact but lost provider identity because MissAV/123AV/Jable were rendered as plain text buttons without icons.
Progressive advanced filter rows were still difficult to scan and edit on-device.
Category should be a dedicated secondary Catalog page instead of replacing the current top-level page through refreshPage(false).

The previously agreed NetflxCat pattern is a better fit: independent simple=true Catalog page, continuous scroll_button filter rows, native overflow selector for long rows, and a separate advanced-filter task page.

changes.search: Search Hub input keeps a short right-side action title '搜索'; the hint moves to the left input area, reducing wasted horizontal space.
changes.categoryNavigation: The primary Category tab now opens hiker://page/javdb3Filters?page=fypage&rule=&simple=true directly. Category no longer changes jdb3_nav and refreshes the current main page.
changes.categoryCatalog: The existing javdb3Filters route is repurposed into a dedicated NetflxCat-style Catalog page. Type, resource, year and sort are compact continuous scroll_button rows above the poster results. Long rows intentionally use Hiker native overflow / selector behavior.
changes.advancedFilters: Low-frequency month/duration/theme/role/clothing/body/action/play/category filters move to a separate simple=true advanced page. The advanced page uses continuous rows; selections refresh only that page. '完成筛选' uses back(true) so the previous Catalog page closes the edit task and refreshes results.
changes.homeQuickFilters: Home quick filters now set the requested resource condition and enter the independent Category page instead of forcing a same-page category refresh.
changes.externalPlayback: MissAV, 123AV and Jable use the Shared Playback provider icon contract and render as icon_small_3. JavDB official VIP/preview actions use compact icon_2 rows; underlying providerUrl/resolve behavior is unchanged.

delivery.normalStartupForCode: local Entry + local UI1 + local UI2 + local UI3 + validated 3.9.44 local Runtime
delivery.sameScopeEval: Base Runtime core() evaluates Stable patches then UI1 then UI2 then UI3 then page call in the same JDB scope

staticGate: shell version/build/local-entry immutable refs were re-read after upload
shell reuses the existing javdb3Filters page so page count remains 39
all new lazyRule callbacks depend only on explicit arguments and Hiker globals
advanced-filter completion uses documented secondary-page back(true) semantics
provider icons come from the already-localized Shared JAV Playback providers() contract
